name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=inventory (ui_menu sub-domain), descriptor=selection_modal_dispatch. Accurately describes the orchestrator that opens the inventory-selection modal, loops grid input until a slot is confirmed or Esc, plays the close-screen outro, restores the VGA snapshot, and returns confirmed/cancelled. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Open and drive the character inventory-selection modal: slide in char_idx's status screen + inventory grid, loop directional/confirm input until a slot is chosen or Esc, play the 12-frame close outro, restore the saved VGA snapshot, free the slide workspace buffers, and return whether the user confirmed.
logic_summary: fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in(char_idx); reset data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx=0; do { input_result = fd2_inventory_grid_input_step(char_idx, gate_flag); } while (input_result==0) -- grid step returns 0 to keep looping, 1 on slot confirm, -1 on Esc. Then for outro_iter 0..11 call fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step(outro_iter, anim_accumulator_buf, composed_target_buf, bg_snapshot_buf); memmove(0xA0000, bg_snapshot_buf, 64000) restores the VGA snapshot; free the three slide buffers; return input_result != 0xffffffff (true=confirmed, chosen slot left in data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx; false=Esc cancel).

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index of the character whose status screen + inventory grid are shown; passed to fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in and forwarded to fd2_inventory_grid_input_step.
params.reason: Accurate (character index), matches caller usage at all 6 sites, no address residue.

params.name: gate_flag
params.semantics: Selection gate forwarded to fd2_inventory_grid_input_step: 1 = only usable items selectable (item command use/equip), 0 = any slot selectable (swap/give/sort).
params.reason: Accurate (gate flag for slot selectability), consistent with callers (use/equip pass 1; give/swap/sort pass 0) and grid input body, no address residue.

returns.semantics: Boolean (0/1) from (input_result != -1): 1 = user confirmed a slot (index in data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx); 0 = Esc cancel. Callers consume it as != 0.

notes: Clean function; no source-comment edit and no Ghidra change needed. Source comment (status.c lines 543-565) and Ghidra plate are both accurate, ASCII, and mutually consistent. Note: source header says '(3 callers)' = 3 distinct caller functions (fd2_handle_tile_event_interaction, fd2_process_battle_drop_entries, fd2_item_command_menu_dispatch); plate says 'Callers (6 sites)' = 6 call sites (item_command_menu calls it 4x). Both verified via get_xrefs_to; not contradictory. Decompile shows raw param_1/param_2 on the Ghidra side; source declaration already uses char_idx/gate_flag, so param renames are keep (any Ghidra-side param naming is a Stage 2 concern).
